steps.name: docker-seed-base
steps.command: docker run --rm --user root -v codesite_overlay_base_be390194df60:/base vectant-runtime:local /bin/bash -lc mkdir -p /base/src && printf "before\n" > /base/src/app.txt && printf "old\n" > /base/src/old.txt && chown -R rootless:rootless /base

steps.name: docker-overlay-setup-as-root
steps.command:
docker exec --user root codesite-overlay-proof-be390194df60 /bin/bash -lc set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /workspace /codesite/overlay/upper /codesite/overlay/work
